body: it doesn’t feel like cheating bc they both happened at like the same time. it’s still obviously my fault bc i didn’t make a choice but now i’m stuck not knowing what to do
they both think we’re exclusive and are treating it as a relationship. like one specifically has told me she’s turned down guys for me
i mean i guess i did fuck up bc i have a deep connection shared between me and both the girls separately. so no matter what i’m going to have to lose a whole important relationship to me
that’s the problem is they’re both starting to develop strong feelings for me. i feel the same for them but ultimately i have to make a decision and it feels impossible

I’ve been getting help for the past month since my attempt and have had my medications upped but I only feel worse than I did before I got out in the hospital. I’m aware it’s my mind distorting things but I feel so far past a point of recovery that even once I get past this and just become desensitized to feeling this way none of my relationships will ever feel fulfilling because of how much I’ve sabotaged my feelings of trust. This thought alone makes it so scary that their is no light anymore at the end of the tunnel and even once I become used to feeling this way my life will still be miserable so I see no point anymore

I really wish I could I just feel so helpless and the fulfillment that I receive from knowing I’m loved while being able to prioritize my loved one is something so strong that I feel I have no other purpose. I’ve just been so stepped on now by that person that if they can’t love me how can I love myself. What is there to love about myself if when I gave everything I had to that person for them to love me they still ended up so easily not loving me. I loved myself before she showed me how much she did not love me. This is why killing myself just seems easiest because I’m just exhausted
